diagnosis: BUG-0124 reproduce: in phase review a tool write of .codictator/reviews/T-0116-r1.json is blocked. Root cause: checkWriteWithinPlan (features/workflow/writes.ts) allowedKind returns false for every non-doc path in review, the findings path is tamper under isProtectedPath (kernel/shell-bypass.ts, used by core/no-bypass in integrity-guards-repo.ts checkProposedWrites and integrity/self-protection.ts toolFormHit), and workflowGatesReal (packs/enforcers/workflow-real.ts) blocks any write in review while the completed review round is missing. BUG-0128 reproduce: task phase next from record reports CDX-E604 for staged history entry and bug row update with remediation that only says run task phase next. Root cause: missingRecordEvidence (features/workflow/phases.ts) reads self-declared flags historyStaged and bugRowUpdated that only task amend sets, e604MissingGate remediation loops to the same command, and workflowGatesReal blocks the record-phase history write until the flag is set.
